purpose: Test the smallest circle/lens/nil finite ansatz for a GR TT response block.

scientific_status.what_it_shows: A lens-shear finite ansatz can realize the TT/gauge rank pattern without observed GR data.
scientific_status.what_it_does_not_show: It does not prove MTT selected this ansatz, nor does it fix G_eff.

next_gate.name: LensShearProjectionSourceSearch
next_gate.question: Does the corpus or selected branch data independently identify the two lens shear strains as the TT metric response directions with unit relative normalization?
